fichas.title: Indoor Public Pools: Planning Requirements
fichas.summary: Planning guidance for indoor public swimming pools covers plot size and slope, parking provision, and subsidiary spaces. Plot area is related to planned pool water area; entrance and entrance-hall areas are also specified as proportions of water area. The room-relationship diagram distinguishes minimum and additional facilities and indicates direct or possible direct access.
spaces: Cash desk or automated paying area
furniture_equipment: Cash desk or automated paying area

dimensions.label: Plot area per planned pool area
dimensions.context: Indoor pools without parking; plot area relative to planned pool area.
dimensions.ocr_raw: For indoor pools (without parking) allow a plot size of 6-8 m2 per m2 of planned pool area

dimensions.label: Additional open-air area increase to total plot size
dimensions.context: Terraces, sun decks, or sunbathing lawns may add this amount to the total plot size.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Additional open-air areas (terraces, sun decks, sunbathing lawns) can add about 10-20% to the total plot size.

dimensions.label: Maximum plot slope
dimensions.context: A flat plot or one with this maximum slope enables a one-level public indoor pool design.
dimensions.ocr_raw: A building plot which is flat or with a max. slope of 15° enables the design of a public indoor pool on one level

dimensions.label: Car parking provision
dimensions.context: One car parking space per 5–10 swimming-pool clothes lockers.
dimensions.ocr_raw: 1 car parking space per 5–10 clothes lockers for the swimming pool.

dimensions.label: Clothes lockers per car parking space
dimensions.context: Swimming-pool clothes lockers; parking ratio is one car space per this number of lockers.
dimensions.ocr_raw: 1 car parking space per 5–10 clothes lockers for the swimming pool.

dimensions.label: Bicycle parking provision
dimensions.context: One bicycle space per five swimming-pool clothes lockers.
dimensions.ocr_raw: 1 bicycle space per 5 clothes lockers for the swimming pool.

dimensions.label: Additional spectator parking provision
dimensions.context: Additional parking when spectator facilities are provided: one space per 10–15 spectators.
dimensions.ocr_raw: If there are facilities for spectators: 1 additional parking space for every 10–15 spectators.

dimensions.label: Spectators per additional parking space
dimensions.context: Applies when facilities for spectators are provided.
dimensions.ocr_raw: If there are facilities for spectators: 1 additional parking space for every 10–15 spectators.

dimensions.label: Additional catering parking provision
dimensions.context: Additional parking when catering is included: one space per 4–8 seats.
dimensions.ocr_raw: If catering is included: 1 additional parking space for every 4–8 seats.

dimensions.label: Seats per additional catering parking space
dimensions.context: Applies when catering is included.
dimensions.ocr_raw: If catering is included: 1 additional parking space for every 4–8 seats.

dimensions.label: Area in front of entrance
dimensions.context: Area in front of the entrance relative to water area.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Area in front of entrance: 0.2 m2/m2 of water area.

dimensions.label: Entrance hall floor area

dimensions.ocr_raw: Entrance hall: floor area 0.15-0.25 m2/m2 of water area

dimensions.ocr_raw: Also 5 m2 wind lobby

fichas.title: Indoor Public Pools: Design Examples
fichas.summary: A comparison table presents indoor-pool design examples for total water-area categories up to 300, 450, 600, 750, and 800 m². It lists pool types and dimensions, water areas, diving facilities, and recommended plot areas without parking. Pool-size notation is width on the diving-board side by length in the diving direction. The caption states an approximate 2:1 division of water area between swimmers and non-swimmers.
